description: This file defines the RawFilter class in Twig, which extends FilterExpression to create a 'raw' filter that outputs content without escaping. It handles construction and compilation of the filter node within the Twig templating engine.

classes.name: RawFilter
classes.description: A Twig filter expression class that represents the 'raw' filter, allowing content to be outputted without escaping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for RawFilter; initializes the filter node with default 'raw' filter and deprecation warning if node is not an AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.
